name: Banishing Ward
text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the chosen friendly model or unit end, and enemy spells and animi cannot target it. Upkeep.

name: Crimson Veil
text: The melee weapons of a friendly Cryx model gain Blood Shadow. Upkeep.

name: Crippling Grasp
text: The target enemy model or unit has -2 SPD, DEF and ARM, and -2 on its melee damage rolls. Upkeep.
verify: Offensive with no POW: the cast is an attack roll that rolls no damage; on a hit cryCripplingGrasp puts the upkeep effect (-2 SPD, DEF, ARM and -2 melee damage rolls) on the model hit. Single enemy model only; the unit version is not built.

name: Mirage
text: The chosen friendly Cryx model or unit gains Apparition. Upkeep.

name: Venom
text: A 10 inch spray of corrosive spit: every model hit takes magical damage and suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.
